brief.ask: Create a brand identity for Tallyline, the invoicing and cash-flow forecasting product in this folder.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: calm and trustworthy, friendly to freelancers, not the generic fintech blue-and-green. Web app only.

claim.notes: Her iki eskiz incelemesinde eleştirmen üç yön için de 'none' seçti (eşittir işareti, UI kartı, çubuk grafik gibi okunuyorlardı); hiçbir konsept geliştirilmedi veya kapıdan geçmedi.

concepts.title: Tally to line
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 a bar chart (finance cliché) or comb; s2 a squiggle or 'mn' worm; s3 a ruler or comb; s4 the letters 'NL' with a strike, which is not legible at 16 px. s2 is the friendliest but is a stock wiggle. Different move: abandon ticks and bars and make one distinctive silhouette.

concepts.title: Runway
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 a stair/step icon or squared S; s2 a 'P' with a note; s3 a UI block with a search slot; s4 a bent pipe or letter S. The step idea is generic chart or stair language, and s4's cut end looks accidental. Different move: find a form that carries 'runway' without stairs or S-curves.

concepts.title: Settled
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 a lowercase 'e'/'2' blob; s2 a UI tab or toggle; s3 a horseshoe/pill U; s4 two stacked UI cards. None is ownable, and the double-rule idea reads as UI or letters. Different move: drop the slab and draw a specific, asymmetric object or gesture.
